programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc: According to Albanian tradition, the man is the head of the house - he provides for the family and defends its honor.The woman is his property, has a lower status and cannot inherit.However, Albania is a country where women can become equal to men after taking an oath.Martyna Wojciechowska meets two sworn virgins who enjoy male privileges.Marte, 86, runs a farm in the countryside.Her father decided that she would become a man.Diana is 59 years old and a sworn virgin because she has always felt like a boy.He photographs, paints and fishes.

programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc: Manila is a city with one of the highest population density in the world.People are looking for a roof over their heads even in cemeteries.The heroine of the episode, Anelaine Banaga, is a mother of five children who lives with her husband in a tomb in one of the largest cemeteries in the Philippines.Martyna Wojciechowska learns about her everyday life.During the day, the woman raises children, earns a living by cleaning graves and running a small shop.For the night, he returns to the tomb with his entire family, where he falls asleep on mats in the presence of four bodies.

programs.title: Shocking dishes
programs.desc: This time, Jarosław Nowak's goal is Kazakhstan.It is a country of contrasts, where you can see wild, green steppes and, on the other hand, modern, rapidly developing cities.First, the host visits Almaty, where he tries to discover what Kazakhs consider the strangest delicacy.He sees a traditional slaughterhouse and the world's largest camel farm.His plate includes sheep's head, camel meat and horse meat, which the local population considers to be Kazakh doping.According to culinary tradition and ancient customs, no part of the dish can be wasted, and the preparation of the dish itself is a real celebration.
